description: An administrator demoted on the stock Dashboard: credentials.json's admin makes accessroles-suite-probe.mjs's own administrator (suiteprobe-admin2, in a narrow library role) a non-admin on jellyfin-web's stock Dashboard page, as a person would (Access Roles has no demote action): Dashboard → Users, its card, 'Allow this user to manage the server' unticked, Save. The probe then checks that the user's token loses the plugins' admin features at the next request. Run by the probe only; it writes nothing else.

steps.name: the page lists the probe's administrator
its user id, from its card
its profile page, loaded, with 'Allow this user to manage the server' ticked
untick 'Allow this user to manage the server'
the server has the user as a non-admin
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const u = await ApiClient.getUser(__vars.target); return !!u && !!u.Policy && u.Policy.IsAdministrator === false; })()

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag and jellyfin-web's Home tab slider excepted)
